journey.title: Enable anonymous public assets
journey.purpose: Change the narrow /public/* policy only when the operator understands the capability and protected application boundary.

steps.intent: Inspect credential readiness and the current public-assets policy.
Review the explicit statement that the primary application remains protected.
Preview the proposed policy change before applying it.
Apply only after the capability-scoped readiness and policy preview are acceptable.

claims.statement: The journey makes it impossible to mistake /public/* asset bypass for anonymous access to the primary application.
